name: Intern InkStone
description: Shanghai AI Lab's Shusheng platform hands out 10 free ink dots a month.
overview: Intern InkStone (书生·端砚) is Shanghai AI Laboratory's model platform, and its ink-dot plan gives every user 10 free ink dots each month during the trial period — renewed monthly rather than granted once. Dots are spent by model and by token class: 1 dot per million uncached input tokens and 4 per million output tokens, so 10 dots is up to 10M input tokens, or far more when the cache is warm. Three of the lab's own models — Shusheng S2, Atria Dawn Preview and Agents A1 — are marked at zero dots, so they cost nothing at all. The endpoint speaks both OpenAI and Anthropic shapes at discovery-api.intern-ai.org.cn/v1, and sign-in is by WeChat QR code.
free_access: 10 ink dots every month, renewed during the trial period
Three lab models cost 0 dots — effectively free

notes: Dots are capped at 10 per five hours and 50 per seven days, so the monthly pool is not spendable at once. Chinese-language platform, WeChat sign-in, and the trial terms can change without notice.
